title: Max Stock Profit
statement:
Find the best profit from one buy and one later sell.

Contract
- `prices` is non-null and holds one price per day, in day order. It may be
  empty.
- You may buy on one day and sell on a strictly later day, at most once. Return
  the largest profit available, or `0` when no profitable pair exists.
- Selling on the buying day is not allowed, so an array shorter than two days
  returns `0`.
- Do not mutate the input array.

Examples
- `maxProfit(new int[]{7, 1, 5, 3, 6, 4})` returns `5` (buy at 1, sell at 6).
- `maxProfit(new int[]{7, 6, 4, 3, 1})` returns `0` because prices only fall.
- `maxProfit(new int[]{})` returns `0`.
hints: Comparing every buying day with every selling day answers the question, but it rereads the same days over and over.
Walk the days once and keep the cheapest price seen so far to the left of the current day.
At each day, the best sale ending today is today's price minus that running minimum; keep the largest such value and never let it drop below zero. Intended complexity: O(n) time and O(1) extra space.
inputSyntax: Input: the daily prices in day order, for example: [7, 1, 5, 3, 6, 4]
